items.title: Kmemo: a semantic cache for LLM calls that refuses to serve you the wrong answer
items.description: An exact-match cache misses "how do I reverse a list in Python" when it has already answered "python list reverse". A semantic cache doesn't: it embeds the prompt, finds the closest one it has seen, and replays that answer instead of calling the model. Fewer API calls, lower latency, same answers
